section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Lumentum All-Stock Acquisition Dilution vs. End-to-End AI Optical Scale
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: Retail traders and skeptical funds blasted Marvell's all-stock deal for Lumentum Holdings—leaving existing MRVL shareholders with roughly two-thirds of the combined company—contributing to a brutal pullback from mid-year highs and price-target trims (e.g., Susquehanna to $225).
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: Bulls argue that owning Lumentum's high-power datacom lasers alongside Inphi's electro-optics DSPs and Celestial AI's photonic fabric creates an unmatched vertically integrated optical interconnect powerhouse for 1.6T/3.2T AI clusters, while 17.76x Forward P/E prices in peak pessimism.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: CEO Matt Murphy: Can you walk through the exact pro-forma EPS accretion, gross margin profile, and capital return plans following the Lumentum transaction to address shareholder dilution concerns?

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Hyperscaler Custom AI ASIC Ramp ($12B FY27 / $18B FY28) vs. Gross Margin Compression
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: Bears note that Marvell's Non-GAAP gross margin is guiding down from 58.9% (Q2) to 57.5%–58.5% (Q3) as lower-margin custom ASICs scale, while persistent rumors around AWS/hyperscaler next-gen socket sharing fuel volatility.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: Data Center revenue surged +45.7% YoY to $2,171.5M in Q2 (79.3% mix) and Q3 overall revenue is guided up +51.8% YoY to $3.15B, putting Marvell squarely on track for ~$12B in FY27 and ~$18B in FY28 with expanding operating-dollar leverage.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: CEO Matt Murphy & CFO Willem Meintjes: What is the expected Q4 revenue split between custom AI silicon and merchant electro-optics, and where does Non-GAAP gross margin trough as custom XPU volumes peak?

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Post-M&A Balance Sheet Leverage ($5.29B Debt) & SBC Jump ($326.2M) vs. True FCF
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: Forensic analysts highlight that total debt rose to $5,286.1M (net debt $1,353.3M vs $3,932.8M cash) and GAAP SBC jumped +57.1% QoQ to $326.2M (up from $207.6M in Q1) following the Celestial AI and XConn acquisitions.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: Even after deducting $131.2M CapEx and $326.2M SBC, Marvell generated +$148.1M in True Forensic FCF in Q2 ($474.3M Reported FCF, $1.72B TTM FCF) and grew GAAP Operating Income +52.9% YoY to $456.9M.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: CFO Willem Meintjes: How much of Q2's $326.2M SBC was tied to Celestial AI and XConn retention awards, and what is your leverage and free cash flow conversion target exiting FY27?
